Subject: Regional hosting + VPC controls - Acme tenant requirements

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme is evaluating Redwood for a payments workload that must be EU-only for customer data at rest and in transit. Can you confirm the following as part of our SIG/CAIQ evidence collection?

- Can Redwood guarantee that the customer tenant (logical) will be hosted entirely within EU regions (no cross-region replication outside EU) for both storage and inference traffic?
- Do you offer a Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) option that isolates network egress and supports VPC peering with our account in eu-west-1? If so, what controls map to SOC 2 / ISO requirements (network controls, flow logging, peering ACLs)?
- Please provide the most recent SOC 2 report and a short signed attestation (one-page) confirming regional residency for an EU-only configuration.
- If you have a completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ export that notes any exceptions for regional hosting, please include it.

Timeline: We need these artifacts by EOD Tue (2026-09-14) to keep the procurement window open.

Primary technical contact for follow-ups is myself (Julia). Please copy our compliance mailbox compliance@acme-payments.com.

Appreciate it — short, specific artifacts will do.

Julia Mercer
Head of Security, Acme Payments
security@acme-payments.com

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear list. We're able to support an EU-only hosting configuration and a private deployment model that meets the requirements you're describing. High level:

- EU-only: we can pin a tenant to a dedicated EU region (eu-west-1 or eu-central-1) and disable cross-region replication for customer data. For production rollouts we also support automated region routing policies to ensure inference compute stays in-region.
- Private deployment / VPC: we offer a VPC-private deployment option (customer-managed VPC peering or transit gateway) that disables public egress by default and supports flow logging + VPC flow export to your logging collectors.

I'm attaching a short control matrix and our regional-hosting affidavit. The SOC 2 (Type II) report and our completed SIG export are included as well. If you need a CAIQ snapshot instead I can produce that tomorrow.

Please note a couple of implementation details we should confirm:
1) Which EU region do you want pinned (eu-west-1 vs eu-central-1)?
2) Do you require HSM-backed key management on day one (we support customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations for Private deployments)?
3) Will Acme operate a dedicated AWS account for peering, or should we provision in our Dedicated tenant model?

I'll loop in Aditya (security lead) and Evelyn (deployment PM) to help with the technical artifacts and cut a one-page attestation for your legal team.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Julia — attaching the final materials per your request. Short summary up front:

1) EU-only hosting: Redwood confirms we can run Acme's tenant entirely within EU-bound infrastructure with no automatic cross-region replication of customer data. This configuration is supported in our Private deployment (VPC) and in a Dedicated EU-only tenant model. See attached affidavit (regional_hosting_affidavit_2026-09-13.pdf).

2) Private deployment & network controls: We support VPC peering (customer account) or transit gateway peering for Private deployments. Default posture: no public egress, enforced TLS in transit, flow logs exported to your collector, and support for customer-managed KMS/HSM. The attached VPC control matrix maps these items to SOC 2 categories and lists the operational steps for peering and verification (redwood_vpc_control_matrix_v1.pdf).

3) Evidence artifacts: Attached are our SOC 2 (Type II) report (soc2-report-2025.pdf) and a completed SIG export (sig-completed-answers.xlsx). If you prefer a CAIQ snapshot instead of the SIG spreadsheet, let me know and we will provide it.

4) Exceptions / notes: We do not perform any billing or non-essential metrics export outside the EU for the EU-only configuration. Control owners are listed in the VPC matrix. For high-security workloads we recommend enabling customer-managed KMS and HSM integration — we can include assisted setup as part of the Private deployment onboarding.

Links & next steps:
- Compliance pack (read-only): https://drive.google.com/redwood/acme-payments/compliance-pack
- Jira: SEC-1123 has the implementation ticket and runbooks.

If this satisfies Acme's procurement ask we can route an NDA/contract redline and schedule a short technical alignment call to go over peering details.
